jobs.title: Health Data Protection and Data Licensing Consultant
jobs.description: About Intelance Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments. The role You will check whether a company has the legal right to use the health data its business depends on, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in data and AI companies. Buyers in life sciences want to know that client data is handled lawfully, deleted when it should be, and not used for anything the contracts do not allow. You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report. What you will do Confirm who is the controller and who is the processor for each type of data, and check the data processing agreements in place. Review client contracts to see whether client data may be used to improve AI workflows, test suites or models. Check how data is deleted when contracts end, and whether that is possible where data has shaped models or tests. Review licences for real world data from third party providers, and what happens to them if the company changes owner. Check data transfers outside the UK, including any use of outside AI providers. Check HIPAA readiness where US health data is involved. Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes. What you will bring At least five years advising on data protection in health, pharmaceutical or life sciences settings. Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and international data transfers. HIPAA knowledge is a strong plus. Experience reviewing data processing agreements and data licences. A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate, or le

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain. Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people. You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. jobs.title: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin . At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals. Translate labels from English into German. Map medical lists of terms across different products. Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts. Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams. Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format. About our data environment Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here ! If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles ! This work is completed telephonically. The Care Navigator provides person-centered, culturally responsive, trauma-informed telephonic and technology-enabled navigation services designed to identify unmet health-related social needs and connect individuals to appropriate community-based resources and services. Responsibilities include screening completion, eligibility verification, referral placement, closed-loop referral follow-up, documentation, consent management, and coordination with community-based organizations, managed care organizations, and healthcare partners. Documentation and tracking activities will occur within both internal and external technology platforms. The Care Navigator is expected to maintain compliance with organizational policies, state program requirements, productivity standards, quality metrics, and confidentiality regulations.
